title: Kenyan Peanut Butter Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy dessert inspired by Kenyan flavors, made with peanut butter and topped with a sweet jazzy sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, eggs, and milk.
Pour the peanut butter mixture into the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Using a cookie scoop or your hands, shape the dough into small balls.
Fry the fritters in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve warm with a drizzle of jazzy syrup.
